Chronotech is the rare and highly volatile branch of magitech that manipulates time itself through stabilized chronomagic, powered by anchored spatial-temporal matrices and time-threaded constructs. It offers incredible advantages—short-range temporal reversals, predictive analysis, time stasis, and loop optimization—but is dangerously unstable without proper containment. Even minor applications of Chronotech risk unraveling causality or creating closed time loops. Devices must be housed within stabilization fields, monitored by quantum-feedback sensors, and often synchronized with multiversal constants to remain safe. Uncontained chronodevices may spontaneously regress, duplicate, or disappear. In Multiversal, Chronotech is heavily restricted. The Temporal Law Council governs its use under the Empire, while rogue time-pilgrims, Chronospire explorers, and loop cults outside the Empire deploy it at great risk.
